```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 120)
raw  <- params$raw
degs <- params$degs
go   <- params$go_results
n_up <- sum(degs$logFC > 0)
n_dn <- sum(degs$logFC < 0)
n_terms <- function(key) if (is.null(go[[key]]$table)) 0L else nrow(go[[key]]$table)
```

## Analysis parameters

```{r parameters}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Parameter = c("DEG adj. P-value cutoff", "DEG |log2FC| cutoff",
                "Enrichment adj. P-value cutoff", "Genes in input table",
                "DEGs (up / down)", paste(GO_LABELS, "terms")),
  Value = c(paste("≤", params$deg_pval), paste("≥", params$deg_lfc),
            paste("≤", params$enr_pval), nrow(raw),
            sprintf("%d (%d / %d)", nrow(degs), n_up, n_dn),
            vapply(names(GO_ONTOLOGIES), n_terms, integer(1)))
), col.names = c("Parameter", "Value"))
```

## Volcano plot

Purple: logFC > 0; green: logFC < 0; grey: not significant at the cutoffs above.
The five most significant genes in each direction are labelled.

```{r volcano, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
volcano_plot(raw, params$deg_pval, params$deg_lfc)
```

## Top ranked genes

```{r barplot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(degs) > 0) {
  cat("Genes ranked by sign(log~2~FC) × −log~10~(adj. P-value).",
      "The full table is in `DEG_results_*.csv`.\n\n")
  print(rank_barplot(degs))
} else {
  cat("*No DEGs at the current cutoffs.*\n")
}
```

## GO enrichment

Top 15 terms per ontology. Full tables with gene lists are in `GO_enrichment_*.xlsx`.

```{r go, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6.5, results = "asis"}
for (key in names(GO_ONTOLOGIES)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", GO_LABELS[[key]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  res <- go[[key]]
  if (!is.null(res$error)) {
    cat('<div class="warn">', res$error, "</div>\n\n")
  } else if (is.null(res$table)) {
    cat("*No enriched terms at adj. P-value ≤ ", params$enr_pval, ".*\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    print(go_dotplot(res$table, sprintf("%s (adj. P-value ≤ %s)",
                                        GO_LABELS[[key]], params$enr_pval)))
  }
}
```

## Methods

<div class="methods">

Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were taken from a limma results table
(Ritchie *et al.* 2015) and selected using Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted P-value
≤ `r params$deg_pval` and |log~2~FC| ≥ `r params$deg_lfc`.

Gene Ontology over-representation analysis was run with clusterProfiler
`r pkg_version("clusterProfiler")` (Yu *et al.* 2012) using the org.Mm.eg.db
`r pkg_version("org.Mm.eg.db")` mouse annotation (offline). Gene symbols were mapped
to Entrez IDs, and all `r nrow(raw)` genes in the input table were used as the
background. P-values were adjusted with the Benjamini–Hochberg method; terms with
adjusted P-value ≤ `r params$enr_pval` are reported (clusterProfiler default gene-set
size limits, 10–500 genes).

The Python implementation of this application uses the Enrichr web service instead,
so term lists can differ between the two versions.

Software: `r R.version.string`; shiny `r pkg_version("shiny")`;
clusterProfiler `r pkg_version("clusterProfiler")`; ggplot2 `r pkg_version("ggplot2")`.

</div>
